subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the gear changing mechanism in an automatic transmission system?
solution:
The correct answer is __Universal coupling.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Torque converter__ is a vital component of the automatic transmission system.
 
• The Epicyclic gear arrangement is used for providing different gear ratios.
 
• Fluid coupling is used to transmit rotational power in automatic transmission systems.
 
• Universal coupling is NOT part of the automatic transmission gear-changing mechanism but is used in drive shafts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Torque Converter:**

 
 
• It is a type of fluid coupling used to transfer rotating power from the engine to the transmission.
 
• It allows the engine to spin somewhat independently of the transmission.
 
 
 
• **Epicyclic Gear Arrangement:**
 
 
• Also known as planetary gear, it provides multiple gear ratios in automatic transmissions.
 
• It consists of sun gear, planet gears, and ring gear.
 
 
 
• **Fluid Coupling:**
 
 
• It is used for smooth power transmission in automatic transmissions.
 
• It prevents shock loads during gear shifting.
